while on the surface it's not a major leap (fable 5.5 will be) - i'd argue its still impressive for a few reasons:

- the model formalized Fermat's theorem (originally took 350 years to do) in 30 hours using 1000 fable 5.2 agents. point being its amazing at autonomous long-horizon tasks. so give it a really hard complex problem and let it do its thing.

- it has a remarkable ability to extend beyond a simple chatbot into robotics and science e.g. its the best at controlling external machines.

- the fact its cheaper than opus 5.5 implies its the distilled student of a much larger model (mythos 6 or "model 4")
